products.name: Workspace ONE to Intune Coexistence & Cutover Runbook — Commercial
products.short_description: The operational Workspace ONE to Intune coexistence and cutover runbook — how to run both platforms safely in parallel, the order of operations, go/no-go gates, the cutover sequence per cohort, and a tested rollback. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Run Workspace ONE and Intune side by side — and cut over without chaos

During a migration you inevitably run both MDMs at once, and that's where things break: devices double-managed, Conditional Access locking people out, and no clear go/no-go for cutover. This solution is the operational Workspace ONE to Intune coexistence and cutover runbook — how to run both platforms safely in parallel, the order of operations, go/no-go gates, the cutover sequence per device cohort, and a tested rollback — so the transition is controlled instead of chaotic.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the coexistence model (both MDMs live), the risks (double management, Conditional Access, app conflicts), the cutover sequence and go/no-go gates, and the rollback path.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (both MDM admin access, Entra ID/Conditional Access control, a device cohort plan, change control, a comms channel) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: establish coexistence guardrails, define cohort cutover order and go/no-go gates, execute a cohort cutover, validate, roll back if a gate fails, then repeat per cohort.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — coexistence/dual-management discovery, per-device cutover-readiness validation, a coexistence and cutover status report, safe remediation/rollback helper, and a cohort group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A controlled transition while both MDMs run in parallel — guardrails against double management, go/no-go gates, a per-cohort cutover sequence, and a tested rollback — so the migration window stays calm, proven on a pilot cohort before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • WS1COEX-Discovery.ps1 — discover the current coexistence state (read-only)
    • WS1COEX-Remediation.ps1 — safe rollback helper for a cohort cutover (default -WhatIf)
    • WS1COEX-Report.ps1 — coexistence & cutover status report (read-only)
    • WS1COEX-Set-CohortTargeting.ps1 — build a cohort Entra group and set its membership (default -WhatIf)
    • WS1COEX-Validation.ps1 — per-cohort cutover-readiness gate (read-only)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
